channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Aaroha Musical Wellness to Introduce ‘Bhajan Clubbing’ in Dehradun for Holi Festivities
item.description: Aaroha Musical Wellness will host Bhajan Clubbing in Dehradun on March 2, 2026, featuring Keshavam Devotional Rock Band in a participatory fusion music experience at MJ Grand Inn.

item.title: Royal Stag BoomBox Opens Fourth Edition in Kolkata with Multi-Genre Line-up
item.description: Royal Stag BoomBox opened its fourth edition in Kolkata with performances by Armaan Malik, Fossils and Dino James, launching a four-city tour blending music, gaming and immersive experiences.

item.title: Riders Music Festival Returns to Delhi-NCR with High-Octane Blend of Music and Motors
item.description: Red FM’s fourth Riders Music Festival in Delhi-NCR combined live performances by Nucleya and Papon with drifting showcases, FMX acts and immersive motor experiences.

item.title: Euler Motors Elevates Pallavi Arora to Associate Vice President – Marketing
item.description: Euler Motors has promoted Pallavi Arora to Associate Vice President – Marketing, entrusting her with leading integrated marketing and communications as the company scales in India’s commercial EV market.

item.title: Samsung Electronics India Promotes Shilpa Dureja Puri to Director – New Computing & Wearables
item.description: Samsung Electronics India has elevated Shilpa Dureja Puri to Director Marketing – New Computing & Wearables, expanding her mandate to drive premium positioning and ecosystem growth.

item.title: Saregama India Enters Middle East with Dubai Subsidiary for Music Festivals and Live Events
item.description: Saregama India has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in Dubai with a paid-up capital of AED 1 million, marking its formal entry into the Middle East’s live entertainment and performing arts market.

item.title: IRCTC Highlights Successful Hosting of North East Music Festival in New Delhi
item.description: IRCTC highlighted the successful conclusion of the North East Music Festival 2026, held on February 22 at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in New Delhi.

item.title: Anjunadeep Announces Two-City India Return with Open Air Shows in Mumbai and Bengaluru
item.description: Anjunadeep will stage Open Air shows in Mumbai and Bengaluru on March 14 and 15, 2026, marking its latest expansion in India in partnership with Johnnie Walker Blonde Non-Alcoholic Lemonade.

item.title: Shriram Shankarlal Music Festival Returns to New Delhi, Celebrating Over Seven Decades of Classical Tradition
item.description: The Shriram Shankarlal Music Festival returns to New Delhi from March 6–8, 2026, presenting a three-day celebration of Indian classical music at the Shriram Bharatiya Kala Kendra Open Air Arena.

item.title: Deepali Designs & Exhibits Pvt. Ltd. Elevates IHGF Delhi Fair 2026 with Immersive Design Excellence
item.description: Deepali Designs & Exhibits Pvt. Ltd. conceptualised and executed immersive façade installations and experiential environments for the 61st IHGF Delhi Fair 2026 in New Delhi.
